source_findings.finding: No bootstrap on_tick subscription exists. Repair60,translation61,and Library native-refresh1 subscriptions are conditional;closed settled views require none. Cap/provider/scripted owners may retain necessary research/force EVENT callbacks;this is not a claim of zero callbacks or zero memory.

source_findings.subject: Shared parse work
source_findings.finding: bootstrap constructs a shared authored browser-family set once at control parse. Library private credit exclusion is a four-ID shared map and declaration_cache is lazy. No eagerly built per-player native catalogue is found. Shared parse/modules/prototypes and requested GUI still consume memory.

source_findings.subject: Repair
source_findings.finding: Damage events are native-filtered to walls/gates;only valid player/reciprocal-friendly relevant objects enter the256queue. A60tick pass processes at most8 queue rows,with bounded FIFO table removal and entity/force/surface revalidation. Overflow is a declared nonaccepted event,not completed work;native stress must retain counts and delay.

source_findings.subject: Agriculture/spoilage
source_findings.finding: Agriculture touches the actual event plant/tower force and one named holder. Agriculture refresh and spoilage reconciliation enumerate forces on explicit lifecycle/relevant research events;they do not scan factory entities or run recurring per-tick handlers. Force-count and event-spike costs therefore remain distinct axes.
